chunks: The inmates of Paradise will have a better abode that day, and a better resting place.

key_terms.أَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًا: Better in terms of resting place/nightly abode
key_terms.خَيْرٌ مُسْتَقَرّاً: Better in terms of permanent residence/stability
key_terms.يَوْمَئِذٍ: That day (referring to the Day of Judgment)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the quality of Paradise as a dwelling place compared to Hell?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the eternal tranquility (sakina) of the Ahl al-Bayt and the righteous, contrasting their stable abode with the fleeting, painful rest of the disbelievers. It underscores the concept of 'good resting place' (hasan maqil) as both physical comfort in Jannah and spiritual peace derived from proximity to Divine Truth.
